newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $311 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $311 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $311 million in 24 offerings for Thursday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $131.7 million in 13 issues. The largest is a $40 million Clark County School District, Nev., deal at 1230 EST.
Negotiated sales total $179 million in 11 offerings. The largest is a $35 million California Health Facilities Authority deal through PaineWebber Inc.
There are two issues totaling $47 million on the Reuters possible calendar, meaning underwriters have indicated they may price them on Thursday depending on market conditions.
